purpose: Final Release Closure, Version Bump and Series Seal
versionRationale: Minor release: backward-compatible normative capabilities were added and normative correctness was repaired; Update 19 found no public API breaking change.
releaseStatusReason: 20D fixes only release-evidence/checksum closure defects exposed by the 20C run: it refreshes deterministic Update13/16 evidence to the 1.4.0 release bytes, removes the unavailable .gitignore manifest entry, and teaches the dedicated release job to exclude npm-installed node_modules through .git/info/exclude while retaining the full tracked-tree cleanliness check.
notes: The Update 19 evidence ZIP remains archived byte-for-byte in artifacts/final-release/update19-final-evidence.zip.
Update17 canonical evidence remains the 20C deterministic 1.4.0 regeneration; the unchanged stale check passed in the 20C CI run.
Update13 standalone firewall evidence is refreshed to the exact 1.4.0 standalone bytes produced by build:standalone; both required semantic firewall markers remain PASS.
Update16 authority-audit evidence is refreshed from the unchanged audit generator at packageVersion 1.4.0; authority/reference semantics remain unchanged.

The root SHA256 manifest no longer lists a .gitignore file because the upload path did not create that hidden file. Instead, only the dedicated release-verify job writes node_modules/ to .git/info/exclude locally before npm ci; release:verify still enforces a clean tracked tree and rejects all other untracked drift.
The Update20 regression runner ordering fix from 20C remains in place and passed all post-bump regression commands in the 20C CI run.
The PWA verification baseline remains synchronized to the already-current service worker cache generation; this is release metadata/baseline alignment, not an algorithmic change.
No production engine, normative reference, Scroll, public API, tag or release is changed by 20D.
